result.title: LonGaussian: Tracking Foundation Priors for Long-Context Feedforward Gaussian Reconstruction
result.summary: Reconstructing high-quality, renderable 3D scenes from long videos is essential for robotic perception and embodied intelligence. Many feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction methods rapidly predict 3D scenes from a small set of images, but extending them to longer sequences presents two bottlenecks: jointly processing all views increases GPU memory requirements, while accumulating pixel-aligned predictions redundantly represents the same surfaces and increases storage and rendering costs. We present LonGaussian, a streaming feed-forward framework that reconstructs compact, globally renderable Gaussian scenes from long image sequences with known intrinsics and unknown camera poses. Built on a pretrained streaming 3D reconstruction backbone, LonGaussian decodes long-context geometric features into dense Gaussians. Within each chunk, multi-frame point tracks link repeated observations of the same surface and guide a learned merger to consolidate the corresponding Gaussian predictions. Rendered-depth consistency filtering further suppresses Gaussians from other chunks that incorrectly occlude locally reconstructed surfaces. On DL3DV and RealEstate10K benchmarks, LonGaussian improves novel-view rendering quality while using substantially fewer Gaussians than the evaluated feed-forward baselines.

AI.brief_summary: LonGaussian 提出一种流式前馈 3D 重建框架，在已知内参、未知位姿的长图像序列上解码长上下文几何特征为高斯，并利用块内多帧点轨迹关联同一表面的重复观测、以学习式合并器压缩对应高斯，再用渲染深度一致性过滤抑制跨块错误遮挡。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「跟踪先关联重复观测、再学习式合并」与「渲染一致性过滤错误预测」两条机制，可能为 LVR 长序列中冗余或失效视觉证据的整合与筛除提供可核查的方法线索；但原文面向 3D 场景表示，能否迁移到 latent 推理状态需人工判断。
